items.domain: Signs, work zones and school zones
items.stem: At a stop-controlled intersection with a crosswalk, where should the driver stop?

options.text: Before entering the crosswalk.
options.rationale: Option A is correct. If a stop-controlled intersection has a crosswalk, stop before entering that crosswalk.

options.text: Beyond the crosswalk among pedestrians.
options.rationale: This alternative does not match the cited rule. If a stop-controlled intersection has a crosswalk, stop before entering that crosswalk.

options.text: Only after crossing the intersection.
options.rationale: This alternative does not match the cited rule. If a stop-controlled intersection has a crosswalk, stop before entering that crosswalk.

options.text: At any place that blocks the crosswalk.
options.rationale: This alternative does not match the cited rule. If a stop-controlled intersection has a crosswalk, stop before entering that crosswalk.

items.correct_rationale: Option A is correct. If a stop-controlled intersection has a crosswalk, stop before entering that crosswalk.

items.domain: Signs, work zones and school zones
items.stem: What does a One Lane Bridge warning tell the driver?

options.text: The bridge is intended for passing side by side.
options.rationale: This alternative does not match the cited rule. A One Lane Bridge warning means there is no room to meet or pass another car or truck on the bridge.

options.text: There is no room to meet or pass another car or truck on the bridge.
options.rationale: Option B is correct. A One Lane Bridge warning means there is no room to meet or pass another car or truck on the bridge.

options.text: The driver gains priority over every approaching vehicle.
options.rationale: This alternative does not match the cited rule. A One Lane Bridge warning means there is no room to meet or pass another car or truck on the bridge.

options.text: The road has ended and no bridge exists.
options.rationale: This alternative does not match the cited rule. A One Lane Bridge warning means there is no room to meet or pass another car or truck on the bridge.

items.correct_rationale: Option B is correct. A One Lane Bridge warning means there is no room to meet or pass another car or truck on the bridge.

items.domain: Signs, work zones and school zones
items.stem: What should a driver do at a Low Clearance warning if the vehicle is too tall for the overpass?

options.text: Accelerate to force the vehicle through.
options.rationale: This alternative does not match the cited rule. At a Low Clearance warning, do not proceed if the vehicle is too tall to pass beneath the overpass.

options.text: Ignore the vehicle height.
options.rationale: This alternative does not match the cited rule. At a Low Clearance warning, do not proceed if the vehicle is too tall to pass beneath the overpass.

options.text: Do not proceed beneath it.
options.rationale: Option C is correct. At a Low Clearance warning, do not proceed if the vehicle is too tall to pass beneath the overpass.

options.text: Use the horn as permission to proceed.
options.rationale: This alternative does not match the cited rule. At a Low Clearance warning, do not proceed if the vehicle is too tall to pass beneath the overpass.

items.correct_rationale: Option C is correct. At a Low Clearance warning, do not proceed if the vehicle is too tall to pass beneath the overpass.

items.domain: Signs, work zones and school zones
items.stem: Which direction should traffic bear when barricade stripes descend to the right?

options.text: To the left.
options.rationale: This alternative does not match the cited rule. Stripes descending toward the right direct traffic to bear right.

options.text: Straight into the barricade.
options.rationale: This alternative does not match the cited rule. Stripes descending toward the right direct traffic to bear right.

options.text: Toward whichever side has oncoming traffic.
options.rationale: This alternative does not match the cited rule. Stripes descending toward the right direct traffic to bear right.

options.text: To the right.
options.rationale: Option D is correct. Stripes descending toward the right direct traffic to bear right.

items.correct_rationale: Option D is correct. Stripes descending toward the right direct traffic to bear right.

items.domain: Signs, work zones and school zones
items.stem: What must a driver do for pedestrians in a school crosswalk when no crossing guard is present?

options.text: Yield to them.
options.rationale: Option A is correct. Always yield to pedestrians in a school crosswalk, whether or not a crossing guard is present.

options.text: Proceed because only a guard creates the duty.
options.rationale: This alternative does not match the cited rule. Always yield to pedestrians in a school crosswalk, whether or not a crossing guard is present.

options.text: Honk to make them abandon the crosswalk.
options.rationale: This alternative does not match the cited rule. Always yield to pedestrians in a school crosswalk, whether or not a crossing guard is present.

options.text: Assume they must always wait for the vehicle.
options.rationale: This alternative does not match the cited rule. Always yield to pedestrians in a school crosswalk, whether or not a crossing guard is present.

items.correct_rationale: Option A is correct. Always yield to pedestrians in a school crosswalk, whether or not a crossing guard is present.
